name: Washington, DC
summary: The nation's capital and the Northeast's closing chapter — the monuments, the free Smithsonians, the Capitol, and Arlington across the river.

lodging.name: A hotel near the National Mall or Dupont Circle
lodging.blurb: Mall-adjacent for the monuments; Dupont/Logan for dining and nightlife.

foodMustTry.name: A half-smoke at Ben's Chili Bowl
foodMustTry.blurb: A U Street institution since 1958 — the city's signature sausage.

days.label: Day 26 — The National Mall & Monuments
days.summary: Walk the length of the Mall, memorial to memorial.

item.title: Monuments walk: Lincoln, WWII, Washington, MLK

location.name: Lincoln Memorial
location.address: 2 Lincoln Memorial Cir NW, Washington, DC

item.blurb: From the Lincoln Memorial and its reflecting pool past the WWII, Vietnam, Korean, and MLK memorials to the Washington Monument.

item.title: National Air & Space Museum
item.blurb: The Wright Flyer, the Apollo 11 command module, and more — free, like every Smithsonian.

days.label: Day 27 — Capitol, Archives & the Founding Documents
days.summary: The seat of government and the papers that founded it.

item.title: U.S. Capitol guided tour
item.blurb: Book the free tour ahead through the Visitor Center for the Rotunda and Statuary Hall.

item.title: The National Archives
item.blurb: See the original Declaration of Independence, Constitution, and Bill of Rights.

days.label: Day 28 — Arlington & NMAAHC
days.summary: A somber morning across the river, an essential museum after.

item.title: Arlington National Cemetery
item.blurb: The changing of the guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, JFK's eternal flame, and rows of white headstones.

item.title: National Museum of African American History & Culture

location.name: National Museum of African American History and Culture

item.blurb: The Smithsonian's most sought-after museum — start in the history galleries below ground and work up. Free timed passes recommended.

days.label: Day 29 — Free Day / Northeast wrap
days.summary: Rest and reset before the loop turns south into the Carolinas. Optional ideas below.

freeMenu.title: Tidal Basin & Jefferson Memorial

location.name: Jefferson Memorial
location.address: 16 E Basin Dr SW, Washington, DC

freeMenu.blurb: A quiet loop around the water (spectacular if the loop ever lands you here in cherry-blossom season).

freeMenu.title: Wander Georgetown
freeMenu.blurb: Historic cobblestone shopping district along the C&O Canal and waterfront.
